fa.title: AlphaGenome 2: آموزش AI برای خواندن کل ژنوم انسان

articles.title: UAEF: A framework-agnostic system for closed-loop evaluation of AI agents
articles.excerpt: The Universal Agent Evaluation Framework (UAEF) is a framework-agnostic system for evaluating AI agents. UAEF converts each framework's traces into one canonical format, scores them with 36 built-in metrics across 7 dimensions, and stores results so teams can compare agent versions and catch regressions.

image.alt: Closed-loop data flow: an adapter normalizes a framework trace, the engine scores it, UAEF stores the results, and reports feed the next iteration
